Payout of 5 August is short ₹28,483.41.
The bank credited ₹1,44,888.00 against an expected ₹1,73,371.41. 18 orders sit in this payout. No refund, chargeback or payment in the gateway ledger accounts for the difference, so the cause is not yet identified.
Suggested action: request the gateway's own breakdown for this payout, and check for a dispute debited but not yet reported.
